cases.question: How does nanoporous Pd differ from bulk Pd?
cases.reference_answer: Compared to bulk Pd, nanoporous Pd has extremely high surface area, so surface stress significantly influences lattice strain and macroscopic dimensions, as well as hydrogen absorption behavior. Its large electrochemically active surface area leads to higher currents and faster hydrogen uptake/release. Short diffusion distances enable rapid hydrogen transport and equilibration.
cases.system_answer: Nanoporous Pd has a high surface area and enhanced catalytic and hydrogen absorption properties compared to bulk Pd, due to its porous structure.

cases.question: Is smoothing required for the dL/dt data?
